mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, the temperature is 58 degrees under clear skies at Harriet Park, complemented by a gorgeous Full Moon. We are looking at an overnight low of 46 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The Wisconsin Department of Transportation invites you to provide feedback on the US 18/151 Corridor Study. You can attend an in-person meeting on November 18 at Mount Horeb High School or join the virtual session on November 19.

Yoga at Insight Wellness is scheduled for today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or at Lake Lou-ee. On October 28, check out trivia at Paddy Mac's or the Bogey Factory, and don't forget the Main Street Trick or Treat event on October 29.

In a report regarding a noteworthy call for service on October 25, officers responded to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they located a 40-year-old Verona man passed out behind the wheel, resulting in an arrest for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is Pumpkin Pecan. The Verona location is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight.
